donorRule: Donors inform behavior; code is copied only when license/provenance is explicit and the dependency fits current doctrine.
rules: No third-party CDN JavaScript in production or the ChatGPT widget.
No ad, analytics, remote-image, YouTube, or arbitrary upload endpoints from donor demos.
Local file intake uses browser File/Blob APIs only and never grants server write authority.
Unknown or absent donor licenses are concept-only and are not copied.
Production dependencies must be vendored/self-hosted and pinned before activation.
